params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry this reads; its point colours are set, or vector lines added, and the geometry passed on.

params.name: Attribute
params.description: The point attribute shown. Ramp colours points by its value (first component); Vector draws it as a line from each point.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Ramp colours each point by the attribute's value; Vector draws a line from each point along the attribute as a direction.

params.name: Ramp
params.description: The colour scale values are mapped through, from the low end to the high end.

params.name: Range
params.description: Auto spreads the ramp from the attribute's lowest to highest value over all points; Manual uses From and To.

params.name: From
params.description: The value shown at the low end of the ramp. Values below it are clamped to that end.

params.name: To
params.description: The value shown at the high end of the ramp. Values above it are clamped to that end.

params.name: Blend
params.description: How the ramp colour meets the existing colour: Set replaces it, Multiply tints it, Add brightens it. Opacity then fades toward the result.

params.name: Opacity
params.description: How far each point's colour moves from its old colour toward the blended ramp colour: 1 is fully, 0 not at all.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Multiplies the attribute's vector to get the drawn line's length, in world units per unit of the attribute.

params.name: Group
params.description: A point group limiting which points are coloured or get a line. Empty means every point; Auto range still measures all points.
